items.quote: And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk, the God which fed me all my life long unto this day
items.claim: Jacob blessed Joseph and invoked God who walked with Abraham and Isaac and sustained him throughout his life

items.quote: The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads
items.claim: The Angel redeemed Jacob from all evil; Jacob requests this Angel bless Joseph's sons

items.quote: let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac
items.claim: Jacob's name and the names of Abraham and Isaac are to be placed upon Joseph's sons
items.object: my name, name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac

items.quote: let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth
items.claim: Jacob requests that Joseph's sons grow into a multitude within the earth
items.place: in the midst of the earth
